text: dsh-tavily-cxykyw 是 DSH 的网页搜索提供方，通过 ctx.web 注册 Tavily 搜索，并由 bundle 将默认搜索提供方设为 tavily。它把查询和 Tavily API 密钥发送到 Tavily 搜索接口，将返回的答案及网页标题、链接和摘要映射为 DSH 搜索结果；搜索深度和结果数量可配置。适合希望在 DSH 网页能力中使用 Tavily 搜索的用户，使用前需要 Tavily API 密钥。

dsh-tavily-cxykyw adds Tavily as a DSH web search provider and selects it in the bundle. It sends searches to Tavily, then maps its answers and web links, titles, and snippets into DSH results. Search depth and result count are configurable; a Tavily API key is required.
想让 DSH 的网页搜索改用 Tavily。
我想在 DSH 搜索网页时拿到真实搜索引擎的结果。
How can I use Tavily for web searches in DSH?
dsh-tavily-cxykyw 的功能「Tavily 网页搜索」：将 DSH 搜索查询发送至 Tavily，并把返回答案、网页标题、链接和摘要映射为标准搜索结果。
dsh-tavily-cxykyw 的功能「搜索结果配置」：可设置 basic 或 advanced 搜索深度以及默认结果数量（1–20，默认 8）；每次搜索也可用请求中的 maxResults 覆盖默认数量。
dsh-tavily-cxykyw 使用前须知：搜索需要 Tavily API 密钥；每次搜索会将查询和密钥放入发往 api.tavily.com 的 POST 请求，并从该服务获取结果。

dsh-tavily-cxykyw README · dsh-tavily-cxykyw：[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

A [Tavily](https://tavily.com)-backed `WebSearchProvider` for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web capability seam (`ctx.web`).

It routes the built-in `web_search` tool to Tavily's dedicated search API instead of the shipped DeepSeek model-based search channel, so **a search costs no model tokens** and the result set comes from a real search engine index rather than an auxiliary model request.

dsh-tavily-cxykyw README · dsh-tavily-cxykyw：Verified against DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`.

> Package name note: `dsh-web-search-tavily` on npm belongs to another author. This plugin is published as **`dsh-tavily-cxykyw`**; the GitHub repository is still `cxykyw/dsh-web-search-tavily`.

dsh-tavily-cxykyw README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tavily-cxykyw
```

If your DSH profile is a pnpm workspace root (the default `~/.dsh/profiles/web` is), the add must target the workspace root:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tavily-cxykyw -w
```

dsh-tavily-cxykyw README · Install：The bundled `cordis.patch.yml` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so adding the package also registers it as a profile bundle: the provider row is inserted **and** `web.searchProvider` is set to `tavily` for you. Restart `dsh web` afterwards — bundle changes are not hot-reloaded.

From a checkout instead of npm:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/cxykyw/dsh-web-search-tavily.git
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-web-search-tavily -w
```

dsh-tavily-cxykyw README · Configure the API key：Get a key at [app.tavily.com](https://app.tavily.com) (there is a free tier). Then pick **one** of:

**1. Credentials file (recommended — outside every repository):**

```yaml

dsh-tavily-cxykyw README · ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml：TAVILY_API_KEY: tvly-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```

**2. Environment variable** of the process that launches DSH:

```sh
TAVILY_API_KEY=tvly-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx dsh web
```

**3. Literal key in your own profile patch** (works, but keeps the secret in a plain file — prefer 1 or 2):

```yaml

dsh-tavily-cxykyw README · ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：- id: web-search-tavily
  config:
    apiKey: tvly-xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```

> **Never commit an API key.** This repository, its `cordis.patch.yml`, and its published npm tarball contain **no** credentials and no default key: the plugin only ever reads them from your machine at search time. `.gitignore` also excludes `.env*`, `.npmrc`, and `*.local.yml`.

dsh-tavily-cxykyw README · Options：| Option | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKey` | — | Literal Tavily API key. Prefer `apiKeyEnv` + credentials/env. |
| `apiKeyEnv` | `TAVILY_API_KEY` | Credential reference / environment variable name to resolve the key from. |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.tavily.com` | Tavily API base URL (point it at a proxy if you need one). |
| `searchDepth` | `basic` | `basic` (fast, 1 credit) or `advanced` (deeper crawl, more credits). |
| `maxResults` | `8` | Results requested per search, 1–20. A per-call `maxResults` still wins. |

dsh-tavily-cxykyw README · Options：Example, overriding just the depth and result count:

```yaml

dsh-tavily-cxykyw README · ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：- id: web-search-tavily
  config:
    searchDepth: advanced
    maxResults: 5
```

dsh-tavily-cxykyw README · Switching providers：The bundle patch already pins the seam:

```yaml
- id: web
  config:
    searchProvider: tavily
    fetchProvider: http

To fall back to the official DeepSeek search, set `searchProvider: deepseek-official` (or remove the line only if `deepseek-official` is the single usable provider — with two usable providers and no pin, the seam fails closed with `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS`).

dsh-tavily-cxykyw README · Switching providers：> Upgrading from a hand-inserted copy in your own profile patch? Delete that `insert` block and keep only the `- id: web-search-tavily` config override above, otherwise the row id is inserted twice.

dsh-tavily-cxykyw README · Notes and limitations：- No Web settings page: DSH `0.2` cannot mount this plugin's settings section, so the provider is configured through the profile patch only.
- `fetch` (page retrieval) is untouched — it stays on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http`.
- Tavily search results carry no publication date, so `sources[].publishedAt` is not set.

dsh-tavily-cxykyw README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-tavily-cxykyw -w
```
